rationale: GOG explicitly discloses in section 2.1 that users receive a revocable personal 'licence' rather than ownership, mitigating typical deception. The ToS includes protective measures unusual for platforms: 60-day notice before shutdown (section 15), DRM-free downloads, fair refund policies (section 6.7), no arbitration clause, and no class-action waiver. However, pervasive 'purchase' framing (section 6 header, section 6.2) creates surface-level opacity for readers who don't reach section 2.1, and broad termination rights remain.
